summary: The project is in the second phase of an expansion that would dramatically expand renewable natural gas output. Generate Upcycle President Bill Caesar said it’s the latest example of public policy supporting digesters.

title: Battery recycling projects among DOE’s latest $500M grant funding round
summary: Princeton NuEnergy and Nth Cycle are focusing on lithium-ion battery recycling projects to recover critical minerals for manufacturing. The funding comes amid new black mass export restrictions meant to boost domestic supplies.

title: EverestLabs adds AI agent to its MRF robotics offerings
summary: The Navigator tool aims to make data from sorting equipment easier to interpret through AI-powered recommendations and customized insights. Caglia Environmental and others are piloting the offering.
